faq.q1: How do I book a property?
faq.a1: Simply browse our listings, select your desired dates, and click 'Contact to Book'. The host will receive your request and respond shortly to confirm your stay.
faq.a2: Yes, every host on Rent-A-Room undergoes a strict verification process including identity checks and property assessments to ensure your safety and comfort.
faq.a3: Currently, payments are handled directly between you and the host via our secure messaging system or upon arrival, depending on the host's policy.
faq.a4: Cancellation policies vary by host. You can view the specific cancellation terms on each property's detail page before making a booking.
